name: hero-share-app

frames.best_why: Both headline lines are sharp and complete, with the trust pill and nav in place.
frames.render_note: The recording stops below the headline; download buttons and photo cards are never shown.

tagline: Warm glow behind an oversized two-line slogan and a trust pill.
summary: An app-marketing hero on a warm peach radial glow: slim top nav, a small row of faces vouching for 12,000+ users, and a huge two-line slogan as the centrepiece.
appearance: A full-bleed peach-to-white radial glow behind a small nav bar, a white trust pill and an enormous two-line black headline. Four grey links sit left of a red rounded Download the App button; the pill holds three tiny round faces.
behaviour: The headline words and the trust pill sharpen from a blur as the section enters view while the nav slides in. The recording ends before the two store buttons and three tilted photo cards below appear.
demo_content: Headline 'Share What Matters, Inspire What's Real' and the line Trusted by 12,000+ People.
search_phrases: app landing page with warm gradient
huge slogan and download the app button
trusted by user count pill with avatars
red gradient background with big type
download app call to action in nav
use_when: A consumer mobile app needs a warm, type-led landing banner pushing its download.
avoid_when: The hero runs taller than one screen, so the store buttons and photo cards land below the fold.
customise: Copy, avatar photos and the three card images are inline in the JSX; the radial glow stops and red palette are literal colour values.
weight_why: A handful of elements fading in once; the background is one CSS gradient.

a11y.note: Avatar images in the trust pill have no alt text, and the entrance animation ignores reduced motion.

issues: The recording stops under the headline, hiding the store buttons and three photo cards.
Avatar images inside the trust pill are missing alt text.
polish_why: Confident oversized type on a soft warm glow; missing alt text and a cropped preview trail behind.
